title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12377)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies classification and matrix for five categories of hospitals. It includes the classification according to the functions in alphabetical order with code number, matrix and organizational classification.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
